junctions.shoulder: continuous silhouette bridge with clavicle slope, acromion crest, deltoid volume and axilla floor
junctions.hip: continuous pelvis-to-thigh bridge around independent left/right hip centers
junctions.axilla: front/back shell depth reduction at the authored axilla floor; never overlapping tubes

junctions.knee: front patella depth accent and rear popliteal depth reduction on the same fixed patch
